description: This bar chart illustrates the performance scores of two models, “LLaMA-3-8B-it” and “Ours (Iterative RLHF)”, across seven different datasets and metrics. The horizontal axis, labeled “Dataset and Metrics”, lists the categories: “CSM-8K”, “MMLU”, “HumanEval”, “TruthfulQA”, “ARC”, “MBPp”, “LC-AlpacaEval-2”, and “MT-Bench (x5)”, “Chat-Arena-Hard”, arranged alphabetically. The vertical axis, labeled “Score”, represents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80, with tick marks at 10-unit intervals. For each dataset, there are two bars representing each model; the “LLaMA-3-8B-it” model is represented by blue bars, and the “Ours (Iterative RLHF)” model is represented by orange bars. The “CSM-8K” dataset shows scores of approximately 73 for “LLaMA-3-8B-it” and 68 for “Ours (Iterative RLHF)”, while the “Chat-Arena-Hard” dataset shows scores of approximately 5 for both models. The bars are grouped side-by-side for each dataset, allowing for a visual comparison of the two models’ performance on each metric, and no bars are visually emphasized.
